rows.commentary: 6.5: Arshdeep Singh fires it in full outside off to Daryl Mitchell, who stays deep and pushes it right back down the pitch.
6.6: Arshdeep pulls his length back at the stumps, allowing Mitchell to watch it closely and dead-bat it to the bowler.
7.1: Auqib Nabi challenges Nicholls down the track as the advancing batter shimmies and skewing a heavy inside edge straight back onto his pad.
7.2: Auqib holds a good length outside off as Nicholls steps out again, angling a defensive push toward the on-side.
7.3: Auqib slides a fuller delivery across, and Nicholls prods it out firmly toward the leg side.
7.4: Auqib oversteps after drawing a wild waft from Nicholls, yielding an extra and a free-hit.
7.4: Auqib drags it wide past the tramlines, conceding a wide as Nicholls flashes hard and misses on the cut.
7.4: Auqib bangs it in short and wide, watching Nicholls swivel across the line of the pull and miss entirely.
7.5: Auqib angles one into the body, allowing Nicholls to work it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
7.6: Daryl Mitchell clears his front leg for a massive heave, getting a thick edge that sails over the slips and races to the boundary.
8.1: Anshul Kamboj pitches it up on off stump, meeting a straight defensive drive from Nicholls aimed straight at mid-on.
8.2: Anshul delivers a wide one that Nicholls lashes toward backward point, where Axar executes a brilliant dive to save the boundary.
8.3: Anshul Kamboj alters his length outside off, catching a thick edge off Nicholls that eludes the lunging KL Rahul and a visually blocked Rohit Sharma at slip to race away to the rope.
8.4: Anshul Kamboj breaches the defense of Nicholls, clattering into the stumps to claim a prized breakthrough in his opening over and leave New Zealand three down.
19.1: Gurnoor Brar drops it short of a length, and Tom Latham sharply calls the wait before defending it solidly toward point.
19.2: Gurnoor Brar strikes with a 141kph lifter outside off, forcing Tom Latham to fetch the pull from afar and top-edge a catch safely into Naman Dhir's hands at deep square leg.
19.3: Gurnoor Brar fires a beauty that nips back sharply from a good length, beating Glenn Phillips as he shoulders arms.
19.4: Gurnoor Brar clocks 140kph with a short of length delivery, zipping straight over Glenn Phillips's attempted cut.
19.5: Gurnoor Brar targets the stumps on a short of length, and Glenn Phillips gets right behind it to block.
19.6: Gurnoor Brar completes a double-wicket maiden as Glenn Phillips miscues another 141kph pull into the swirling wind, allowing Anshul Kamboj to judge and secure the catch at fine leg.
20.1: Axar Patel drifts one in toward the leg stump, and Daryl Mitchell attempts a reverse-sweep straight to backward point.
20.2: Axar Patel slides one straight on with the arm, rapping Daryl Mitchell on the pad as he misses his glance.
20.3: Axar Patel flights this one at 95kph down the leg line, allowing Daryl Mitchell to nudge it away toward square leg.
20.4: Axar Patel bowls a fullish delivery that Daryl Mitchell reverse-sweeps past a sprawling Gurnoor Brar at short third man for a single.
20.5: Axar Patel delivers a flat length ball from over the wicket, punched cleanly through the point region for a run by Mitchell Santner.
20.6: Axar Patel rushes through a quick length ball on the stumps, forcing Daryl Mitchell to defend it into the off side.
21.1: Gurnoor Brar digs this in short to Mitchell Santner, who rises on his toes to dead-bat the delivery into the pitch.
21.2: Gurnoor Brar targets a back-of-a-length spot, allowing Mitchell Santner to punch it firmly towards the cover fielder.
21.3: Gurnoor Brar rattles in another testing length delivery that Mitchell Santner safely negotiates from within his crease.
32.3: Axar Patel darts a ninety-two kph delivery into the leg stump, where Daryl Mitchell attempts the reverse-sweep only to find backward point.
32.4: Axar Patel tosses up a ninety-five kph ball, swept firmly by Daryl Mitchell through square leg to collect a brace after Naman Dhir's sliding stop in the deep.
32.5: Axar Patel arrows in a ninety-four kph flat dart on a middle-stump line, solidly blocked back down the pitch by Daryl Mitchell.
32.6: Axar Patel pushes a full one hundred kph delivery through, which Daryl Mitchell drills down to long-off for a single.
33.1: Gurnoor Brar extracts nasty extra bounce from a short-of-length delivery, catching the splice of Daryl Mitchell's defensive bat.
33.2: Gurnoor Brar drops it short, Daryl Mitchell clears the front leg and flashes a fortunate top edge over the keeper to bring up his milestone fifty.
33.3: Gurnoor Brar hurries another short delivery past Mitchell, who withdraws his bat just inside the line before shadow-practising the upper cut.
33.4: Gurnoor Brar delivers a full ball that Daryl Mitchell taps firmly toward point, immediately sparking a tense, frost-bitten verbal exchange between the pair.
33.5: Gurnoor Brar attacks the channel with a length ball, prompting an easy leave from Mitchell and a theatrical, marching clap from the fast bowler.
33.6: Gurnoor Brar bangs it back of a length outside off, and Mitchell rides the bounce to punch a single toward deep point.
34.1: Axar Patel floats this full delivery drifting into the pads, prompting Daryl Mitchell to lean across and work an inside edge down toward short fine leg for a single.
34.2: Axar Patel lands a length delivery just outside off, calmly blocked by Mitchell Santner in the direction of point.
34.3: Axar Patel targets the stumps with a full delivery, pushed directly back down the track by Santner.
34.4: Axar Patel drops slightly short with a hint of away-drift, stabbed firmly by Santner out to sweeper cover for a comfortable single.
34.5: Axar Patel entices a reverse-sweep from Mitchell, but Virat Kohli dives sharply at backward point to intercept the cleanly struck ball.
34.6: Axar Patel outsmarts Mitchell as the batter dances down the track, slicing a misjudged lofted shot straight to Anshul Kamboj at long-off.
35.1: Gurnoor Brar steams in at 138kph, darting an in-angled delivery straight to the midwicket fielder.
39.6: Gurnoor Brar caps off a magnificent ten-over masterclass clocking 142kph as Jacob Duffy wisely lets the back-of-a-length delivery sail through to the keeper.
40.1: Anshul Kamboj digs in a 130kph bouncer that tracks the backing-away Blair Tickner, pinging him flush on the helmet grille and prompting immediate concern from the bowler and KL Rahul.
40.2: Anshul Kamboj delivers a short of a good length ball holding its line outside off, leaving Tickner swinging into empty air after backing away to slash.
40.3: Anshul Kamboj attacks the stumps with a back-of-a-length delivery, allowing Tickner to clear room and flat-bat a single down towards long-on.
40.4: Anshul Kamboj pitches on a good length just outside off, prompting Duffy to stay on his crease and punch the ball firmly toward cover.
40.5: Anshul Kamboj angles a short of a good length delivery into Duffy, who catches it high on the bat while shaping to pull, steering a single down to long-on.
40.6: Anshul Kamboj seals the innings with a 135kph yorker that shatters the base of the middle stump after Tickner backs away too far, bundling New Zealand out for 134.
8.1: Jamieson finds that probing channel just outside off, pinning Rohit down into a disciplined defensive stance.
8.2: Jamieson drifts onto the pads, and Rohit effortlessly whips it over square leg for six.
8.3: Kyle Jamieson targets the full length and coaxes Rohit Sharma into a forward lunge, leaving the right-hander grasping at thin air as the ball whispers past the outside edge.
8.4: Jamieson claims his man as Rohit goes hard at a fuller delivery outside off, finding the thick edge for Nicholls to safely pouch at second slip.

8.5: Kyle Jamieson extracts steep lift with a vicious short delivery that climbs abruptly into Axar Patel, catching the shoulder of the bat and helmet before dying safely short of a diving Glenn Phillips running in from backward point.
8.6: Jamieson angles one across from a short of a length, leaving Axar completely flat-footed and swinging into empty air.
9.1: Nathan Smith hits a short of a good length just outside off, easily blocked straight back to the bowler by Shreyas.
9.2: Nathan Smith delivers on a sound length, allowing Shreyas to steer it neatly behind square on the off-side for a single.
9.3: Nathan Smith digs it in short to generate sharp extra bounce, catching Axar on the gloves as he smartly drops his hands.
9.4: Nathan Smith shapes one away on a length, leaving Axar reaching wildly with no foot movement and missing entirely.
9.5: Nathan Smith pitches it slightly fuller on off stump, comfortably push-driven right back down the pitch.
9.6: Nathan Smith bangs it short of a length, rendering Axar's frantic charge down the track completely futile as the ball sails past the bat.
10.1: Jamieson tests the corridor with a short of a good length, and Shreyas opens his stance to dead-bat it firmly toward the off-side.
10.2: Jamieson digs it in sharply, extracting alarming extra bounce that leaves Shreyas reaching and entirely beaten on the cut.
10.3: Jamieson probes that same probing channel outside off, and Shreyas flashes past the line yet again with no contact.
19.1: Kyle Jamieson targets the cut, but the delivery stays low and skids beneath Shreyas Iyer's bat.
19.2: Shreyas Iyer attempts a dab outside the off stump, squeezing an under-edge that trickles toward slip.
19.3: Kyle Jamieson offers a full length, punishingly lofted by Shreyas Iyer over mid-off with pure timing.
19.4: Shreyas Iyer opens the face to drive, thwarted instantly by Glenn Phillips diving sharply to his left at backward point.
19.5: KL Rahul sends Shreyas Iyer back decisively after a back-of-a-length ball prompts a frantic dash covered quickly by Glenn Phillips.
19.6: Kyle Jamieson digs in a fierce 136kph snorter that clips Shreyas Iyer's top-edge for Tom Latham to safely gather.

20.1: Jacob Duffy angles it in short, Rahul hops to poke it toward backward point, and a frantic single results as Glenn Phillips attacks the ball and fires past the stumps with Naman Dhir scrambling.
20.2: Jacob Duffy delivers on a length, and Naman Dhir meets it solidly to block it straight back into the bowler's hands.
20.3: Jacob Duffy digs it in short around off, allowing Naman Dhir to swivel and pull it powerfully through backward square leg for a single.
20.4: Jacob Duffy drops it full outside off, Rahul throws the hands into a booming cover drive and inside-edges the ball sharply onto his pad.
20.5: Jacob Duffy steams in at 132kph to land a controlled length delivery, which Rahul dead-bats softly toward mid-on.
20.6: Jacob Duffy clocks 134kph with a sharp bouncer sliding down leg, prompting Rahul to initially shape for the pull before withdrawing his bat at the final fraction of a second.
21.1: Jamieson delivers a full one at 134kph that curls inward, catching the hard-handed drive of Dhir with a thick inside edge that races away to fine leg.
21.2: Jamieson steams in at 137kph with a full delivery angling in, prompting Rahul to push it solidly straight back to the bowler.
21.3: Jamieson tests the length with a ball that nips in slightly, causing Rahul to shuffle across his crease and wisely shoulder arms.
21.4: Jamieson fires a 133kph delivery angling toward the leg side, which Rahul manages to nudge away toward square leg off the inner edge for a single.
24.5: Jacob Duffy drops one down leg at 137kph, where Anshul Kamboj tickles an inside edge fine before Kyle Jamieson flies into a full-length right-handed dive to claw the ball off the boundary line.
24.6: Jacob Duffy serves up a full delivery that Rahul meets on the front foot for a defensive push, squeezing an inside edge away through backward square leg.
25.1: Kyle Jamieson targets a back-of-a-length spot, and Rahul turns it toward square leg off the splice of the bat.
25.2: Kyle Jamieson fires down an out-seaming back-of-a-length delivery with steep bounce outside off, prompting Anshul Kamboj to poke tentatively before pulling his bat back just in time.
25.3: Kyle Jamieson strikes as Anshul Kamboj flashes blindly across the line, sending a thick outside edge high toward third man where Jacob Duffy settles underneath to pouch it with both hands.
25.4: Kyle Jamieson digs a short-of-length delivery into the leg stump, allowing Auqib Nabi to guide it away toward deep backward square leg.
25.5: Kyle Jamieson lands a good-length delivery squarely on the off stump, which Rahul stonewalls back down the pitch.
25.6: Kyle Jamieson targets the channel outside off with a short-of-length delivery, and KL steers it smoothly down to third man.

preview.text: New Zealand play India at Hnry Stadium. In 54 recorded one-day meetings, New Zealand have won 23 and India 30. India won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours gives up to a 96 per cent chance of rain, at about 17 degrees.

summary.text: India won by 4 runs (DLS method). NZ made 134-10, Daryl Mitchell top-scoring with 55 off 104 balls; Gurnoor Brar took 4 for 30. IND made 113-7, Shreyas Iyer top-scoring with 30 off 46 balls; Kyle Jamieson took 3 for 35.
